PICO-8 v0.2.7 API signature lines, extracted from pico-8_manual.txt.
Fixture for scripts/check-api.lua so CI can run without the manual,
which ships only with PICO-8 (paid software).

Regenerate with: scripts/make-fixture.sh /path/to/pico-8_manual.txt

    RELOAD(0,0,0X2000, "DAT1.P8") -- LOAD SPRITESHEET FROM DAT1.P8
    LOAD("GAME2.P8")              -- LOAD AND RUN ANOTHER CART
    WHILE(X <= 5) DO
    PRINT(PLUSONE(2)) -- 3
    PRINT(Y)          -- 0
    PRINT(1 != 2) -- TRUE
    PRINT("FOO" == "FOO") -- TRUE (STRING ARE INTERNED)
    _DRAW() is normally called at 30fps, but if it can not complete in time, PICO-8 will attempt to 
    _UPDATE60() 
    FUNCTION_NAME(PARAMETER, [OPTIONAL_PARAMETER])
    LOAD(FILENAME, [BREADCRUMB], [PARAM_STR])
    SAVE(FILENAME)
    LS([DIRECTORY])
    RUN([PARAM_STR])
    STOP([MESSAGE])
    ASSERT(CONDITION, [MESSAGE])
    RESET()
    INFO()
    FLIP()
    PRINTH(STR, [FILENAME], [OVERWRITE], [SAVE_TO_DESKTOP])
    TIME()
    T()
    STAT(X)
    EXTCMD(CMD_STR, [P1, P2])
    CLIP(X, Y, W, H, [CLIP_PREVIOUS])
    PSET(X, Y, [COL])
    PGET(X, Y)
    SGET(X, Y)
    SSET(X, Y, [COL])
    FGET(N, [F])
    FSET(N, [F], VAL)
    PRINT(STR, X, Y, [COL])
    PRINT(STR, [COL])
    CURSOR(X, Y, [COL])
    COLOR([COL])
    CLS([COL])
    CAMERA([X, Y])
    CIRC(X, Y, R, [COL])
    CIRCFILL(X, Y, R, [COL])
    OVAL(X0, Y0, X1, Y1, [COL])
    OVALFILL(X0, Y0, X1, Y1, [COL])
    LINE(X0, Y0, [X1, Y1, [COL]])
    RECT(X0, Y0, X1, Y1, [COL])
    RECTFILL(X0, Y0, X1, Y1, [COL])
    RRECT(X, Y, W, H, R, [COL])
    RRECTFILL(X, Y, W, H, R, [COL])
    PAL(C0, C1, [P])
    PAL(TBL, [P])
    PALT(C, [T])
    SPR(N, X, Y, [W, H], [FLIP_X], [FLIP_Y])
    SSPR(SX, SY, SW, SH, DX, DY, [DW, DH], [FLIP_X], [FLIP_Y]]
    FILLP(P)
    ADD(TBL, VAL, [INDEX])
    DEL(TBL, VAL)
    DELI(TBL, [I])
    COUNT(TBL, [VAL])
    ALL(TBL)
    FOREACH(TBL, FUNC)
    PAIRS(TBL)
    BTN([B], [PL])
    BTNP(B, [PL])
    SFX(N, [CHANNEL], [OFFSET], [LENGTH])
    MUSIC(N, [FADE_LEN], [CHANNEL_MASK])
    MGET(X, Y)
    MSET(X, Y, VAL)
    MAP(TILE_X, TILE_Y, [SX, SY], [TILE_W, TILE_H], [LAYERS])
    TLINE(X0, Y0, X1, Y1, MX, MY, [MDX, MDY], [LAYERS])
    PEEK(ADDR, [N])
    POKE(ADDR, VAL1, VAL2, ...)
    PEEK2(ADDR)
    POKE2(ADDR, VAL)
    PEEK4(ADDR)
    POKE4(ADDR, VAL)
    MEMCPY(DEST_ADDR, SOURCE_ADDR, LEN)
    RELOAD(DEST_ADDR, SOURCE_ADDR LEN, [FILENAME])
    CSTORE(DEST_ADDR, SOURCE_ADDR, LEN, [FILENAME])
    MEMSET(DEST_ADDR, VAL, LEN)
    MAX(X, Y)
    MIN(X, Y)
    MID(X, Y, Z)
    FLR(X)
    CEIL(X)
    COS(X)
    SIN(X)
    ATAN2(DX, DY)
    SQRT(X)
    ABS(X)
    RND(X)
    SRAND(X)
    MENUITEM(INDEX, [LABEL], [CALLBACK])
    TOSTR(VAL, [FORMAT_FLAGS])
    TONUM(VAL, [FORMAT_FLAGS])
    CHR(VAL0, VAL1, ...)
    ORD(STR, [INDEX], [NUM_RESULTS])
    SUB(STR, POS0, [POS1])
    SPLIT(STR, [SEPARATOR], [CONVERT_NUMBERS])
    TYPE(VAL)
    CARTDATA(ID)
    DGET(INDEX)
    DSET(INDEX, VALUE)
    POKE()ed (to output a value -- e.g. to make an LED light up) or @PEEK()ed (e.g. to read
    POKE(0x5F2D, flags)  -- where flags are:
    SETMETATABLE(TBL, M)
    GETMETATABLE(TBL)
    RAWSET(TBL, KEY, VALUE)
    RAWGET(TBL, KEY)
    RAWEQUAL(TBL1,TBL2
    RAWLEN(TBL)
    YIELD() any number of times, and then resumed again at the same points.
    COCREATE(F)
    CORESUME(C, [P0, P1 ..])
    COSTATUS(C)
    CHR(0)..CHR(15) and can be written as an escaped sequence ("\n" for newline etc.)
